Service Delivery Manager | Operational Excellence Leader

✉ Dheerajk.0212@live.in | +91 7840055507 | New Delhi / Gurugram | linkedin.com/in/dheerajkumarops

EXECUTIVE PROFILE

Commercially minded Service Delivery Manager and AI Program Leader with 14 years of cross-industry experience governing large-scale transformation and multi-site service delivery across EMEA and APAC. Bridges the gap between strategic intent and operational delivery — bringing Six Sigma Black Belt rigour, process/operational excellence discipline, and hypothesis-driven consulting methods to complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

Deep expertise across Insurance, eCommerce, Travel, Telecom, and FinTech — with a demonstrable record of translating AI, automation, and process strategy into measurable P&L outcomes. Extensive experience handling global, multi-geography clients — managing stakeholder relationships and service governance across EMEA, APAC, UK and US client portfolios.

Brings structured MECE problem-solving, executive-ready storytelling, and C-suite governance experience together with applied fluency in Generative AI, RPA, intelligent automation, and digital workflow optimisation. Actively certified across Microsoft Azure AI, UiPath AI Fabric, Google AI Essentials, and Prompt Engineering — equipping clients to extract real-world value from AI investment without requiring engineering teams.

Led and mentored 16 Lean Six Sigma projects, including 8 completed Black Belt and 8 completed Green Belt projects, with 2 Black Belt and 4 Green Belt projects currently ongoing across Telecom, Insurance, Finance, AI/Chatbots, eCommerce, and Travel/Air Ticketing domains.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Service Delivery Manager — AI Transformation & Operations Excellence · Webhelp-Concentrix | 2025 – Present | Gurugram

Engaged as internal AI transformation consultant; architecting enterprise-wide process re-engineering and AI- powered delivery programs across Insurance and eCommerce accounts, including global, multi-geography client portfolios — functioning as strategic advisor and execution lead simultaneously.

Global Client Management: Managed multi-geography client relationships and service governance across EMEA, APAC, UK and US portfolios, serving as the primary point of contact for global stakeholders and driving cross- border delivery alignment.

Large Headcount & Multi-site Delivery: Led a high-performing operations team of 200 FTEs across customer experience (CX) and technical support verticals for Fortune 500 clients, spanning multi-site service delivery and workforce management (WFM).

Transformation: Spearheaded end-to-end AI-augmented transformation programs aligned to digital roadmaps, delivering 20% cycle-time reduction and 30% process automation uplift — directly improving client SLA adherence and commercial outcomes.

Intelligent Automation: Deployed UiPath AI Fabric and Automation Cloud extensions alongside RPA, enabling intelligent document processing and agent-assist capabilities — eliminating thousands of manual processing hours across Back Office operations.

AI in CX & Operations: Designed and embedded AI-powered sentiment analysis into CX workflows; leveraged real-time agent assist to improve first-contact resolution and drive a 22% CSAT uplift across UK and EU accounts. • Analytics & Insight: Built and deployed Power BI KPI governance dashboards using predictive models — improving forecast accuracy 21% and accelerating executive decision cycles across multi-account portfolios.

Account Governance: Led QBR forums and executive governance sessions with C-suite and global client stakeholders; achieved 95%+ account retention and secured RFP renewals on improved commercial terms through strategic client management and contract negotiation.

Process Excellence: Institutionalised Six Sigma DMAIC controls, reducing process variation 28% and sustaining 98%+ SLA compliance — applying MECE problem-structuring to surface and resolve root-cause performance leakage.

AI Capability Building: Championed internal AI fluency programs and Copilot-for-Productivity adoption; reduced

training and onboarding costs 12–15% through AI-enabled learning frameworks.

People & Leadership: Built high-performance teams via succession planning and targeted leadership

development — improving internal promotions 20% and engagement scores 25%.

Process Excellence Lead (Assistant Manager) · Webhelp-Concentrix | Oct 2020 – 2025 | Gurugram

Delivered large-scale process improvement, automation strategy, and operational transformation across multi-

account, multi-geography portfolios as the primary client-facing transformation and AI integration lead.

Program Management: Managed end-to-end delivery of transformation programs across 25+ member cross- functional teams and global client accounts — 95%+ SLA adherence and consistent on-time delivery throughout tenure.

Process Reengineering: Led RCA-driven process reengineering initiatives — improving team productivity 18% and

reducing process error rates 22% through structured DMAIC intervention and digital workflow redesign.

Capacity Optimisation: Optimised workflow planning to 85%+ occupancy; reduced operational backlog 30%

through AI-assisted demand forecasting and capacity modelling.

Cost Optimisation: Identified and implemented £25K+ annual cost-saving opportunities through intelligent

automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Client Recognition: Recognised with Best Team Manager Award (4×) for client service excellence and KPI

overachievement; received C-suite appreciation for SLA stabilization during peak volumes.

Engagement & Retention: Reduced team attrition 10% via structured coaching and AI-enabled performance

governance frameworks.

Learning & Development Specialist — Secondment · Fareportal (Travel Domain) | Apr 2019 – Apr 2020 | Gurugram

Embedded internal consultants driving L&D transformation and Lean capability uplift within client operations —

improving resource utilisation and sustaining lasting improvement culture.

Lean Transformation: Implemented Lean methodologies reducing rework in reconciliation and month-end close

processes by 18%.

Six Sigma Mentorship: Mentored 10+ Green Belt projects — improving resource utilisation 12% and recognised

at global client forums for program quality.

Capability Building: Designed targeted coaching programs addressing skill gaps; spearheaded leadership

development and business communication workshops.

Team Coach & Operations Lead · FIS Global Business Solutions (FinTech) | Mar 2015 – Apr 2019 | Gurugram

Led 20+ FTE production team — sustained 97%+ CSAT adherence and RPC targets through SMART/GOAL

coaching frameworks.

Improved productivity 15%, reduced error rates 20%; monitored AHT, adherence, occupancy and quality KPIs.

Operations Associate · John Keells BPO | Apr 2014 – Feb 2015 | Delhi

Top revenue earner for 3 consecutive months; served as Sales Coach for on-the-job training batches.

Associate Trainer · eAgeTutor | Apr 2012 – Apr 2014 | Delhi

Delivered business communication and English language training via e-learning to students and working

professionals.

€500K+ Revenue Protected — Engineered AI-powered volume forecasting and SLA mapping across EMEA —

eliminating underbilling and securing contractual revenue across multi-country portfolios.

30%+ Automation Uplift — Delivered intelligent process automation via UiPath AI Fabric and RPA — reducing

manual effort, accelerating cycle times, and enabling straight-through processing at scale.

22% CSAT Uplift — UK & EU Accounts — Redesigned CX escalation governance and deployed AI sentiment

analysis with agent-assist — directly improving client retention scores and NPS across EU accounts.

€420K–€550K Efficiency Gains — Improved eCommerce operational efficiency 12–15% (FY 2023–24), generating

quantified productivity gains and revenue protection impact through AI-led process intelligence.

€400K+ Billing Revenue Unlocked — Realigned billing models with actual volume drivers using data analytics —

unlocking incremental annual revenue in partnership with Finance and client stakeholders.

€18K–22K Training Cost Savings — Automated learning frameworks via AI-enabled modules and Copilot-for-

Productivity — reducing training costs 12–15% while accelerating onboarding velocity organisation-wide.
